selections.description: Fresh selections, oldest first. Normally consumed on return; peek leaves them unconsumed. Expired selections are omitted.

object.description: Source, page, artifact or task id.

anchor.description: Anchor inside the object, or null for the whole object.

quote.description: Quoted text. Null for a private object.

quote_sha256.description: Staleness hash supplied by the app, or the quote digest when the app omitted one. Null for a private object.

selected_at.description: When the app recorded the selection, RFC 3339 UTC.
